fixed: Typing or pasting a pass the ocean, form short waves, form long waves or form a long wave the way the figure list shows it now gives that figure, with its dancers, hands, direction and balance, instead of unrecognized text or a different move. For example, "pass through to an ocean wave - robins catch left hands in the center, neighbors take right hands on the sides" is a pass the ocean, not a pass through. In the Leads/Follows wording, a pass the ocean whose center pair are leads or follows, a form long waves with the follows facing in, and a long wave the leads dance out of are not read yet. The whole line "robins form a long wave in the center", which was read as the robins dancing in to the wave with a balance, is now read as forming the wave in place, as the figure list means it.

The ContraDB figure reader also reads the app's display wording for `pass_the_ocean`, `form_short_waves`, `form_long_waves` (with `facing`, the pair held and the balance) and an in-place `form_a_long_wave`, and its `dance in to a long wave` subject takes `third corners`, `opposites` and the singulars `neighbor`, `partner` and `shadow`. The display readers read only a whole line. `<who> form a long wave in the center` is now `in: false, out: false` with its stated balance, where the taxonomy defaults used to make it a balanced dance-in. The display's direction phrases moved to `displayDirectionPhrases` in `dance_vocabulary.dart`, which the renderer and the readers share. In Leads/Follows, the pass the ocean lines with a lead or follow center, the form long waves line with the follows facing in, and the leads-dance-out long wave still do not read back. Free-text entry reads a line as typed before it applies the dialect's role words, and for these the as-typed reading already finds a move, with the rest kept as a note, so the role-word reading is never tried.
